statement: How does internal developer AI usage translate into workforce output and productivity?
Internal AI usage by developers and employees drove a 40% to 75% surge in code generation and task velocity
status: shifting the human bottleneck from writing code to code review and architecture.

statement: CODE GENERATION VELOCITY (Google & Meta): Internal AI generation surged from 25% (2024) to 75% (2026) of all newly committed code.
PULL REQUEST & TASK THROUGHPUT (Microsoft): Empirical analysis of 16000+ engineers showed 40.5% higher PR throughput and 55% faster task speed.
LARGE-SCALE SYSTEM MODERNIZATION (Amazon): Amazon Q Developer saved 4500 developer-years by shrinking app migration from 50 days to hours.
AUTONOMOUS MULTI-AGENT SHIPPING (Stripe): Autonomous Minions agents land ~1300 PRs per week directly from Slack workflows.
KNOWLEDGE WORKER LEVERAGE & HYBRID LIMITS (Klarna): Internal AI handled workload of 700-850 FTEs before pivoting to a hybrid quality model.
